thread:
Maya CS: Quick flag — Satori's batch-enroll p95 jumped from ~95ms to ~220ms in 24h. Renewal meeting tomorrow; low usage signal. Propose small proactive perf pilot: int8 quant + 10% traffic to dedicated pool, auto-fallback to fp16. Need approvals and customer consent.

Adarsh RM: Quick Q — any automated eval regressions on their prompt set?

Maya CS: Model-checker shows ~0.7% detokenize diffs on fringe prompts, nothing in main path. Canary with fallback sounds safe.

Jin Eng: I can build "int8-pilot-v1" and add a traffic-split rollout. Will include monitor hooks.

Lucas SRE: I can reserve a small dedicated pool (us-west-2) 02:00-04:00 UTC and enable verbose tracing for the window.

Eve PM: Product asks for a one-pager for the customer: benefits, rollback plan, and opt-out. Also plan a short in-app feedback nudge after the window.

Maya CS: Canary plan draft:
1) build quant artifact int8-pilot-v1
2) route 10% to int8 on dedicated pool
3) monitor p95, token-loss, detokenize-errors for 6h
4) success criteria: QoE delta <1% AND p95 <120ms -> ramp to 100% within 24h
Approve?

Jin Eng: Approve. Rollout snippet: `traffic_split: {"int8-pilot-v1":0.1, "fp16-stable":0.9}, fallback: fp16-stable`

Lucas SRE: Alerts: token-loss >0.5% OR p95 regression >20% -> immediate rollback. Adding capacity toggle.

redwood-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-5555 at 2026-04-12T02:00Z by Jin Eng

Maya CS: I'll request consent: 'We will run a short performance canary with automatic rollback on quality impact.' Will log reply.

Adarsh RM: I'll send a renewal note highlighting perf uplift and the mitigation checklist.

Jin Eng: Will post logs to #eng-runtime and ensure >=500 requests/variant for confidence.

Maya CS: Also enabling a 1-question micro-survey for affected sessions.

Eve PM: No objections, proceed. :thumbsup: 

Lucas SRE: Approved.

Adarsh RM: Approved.

Jin Eng: Approved.

Maya CS: Approved — kicking off artifact build and scheduling.
